answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 19101 Country: India Title: Using artificial technique to get conceived/pregnant Question: WHAT DOES SHARIAT SAYS ABOUT ARTIFICIAL TECHNIQUES FOR PREGNANCY LIKE IUI IN WHICH THE SPERM OF MAN IS INJECTED NEAR WOMB OF WOMEN SO THAT IT ARTIFICIALLY GOES INSIDE WOMB TO MEET EGG OF WOMEN SO THAT SHE BECOMS PREGNANT? IS THIS TECHNIQUE HALAL OR HARAM? Answer ID: 19101 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
